text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув, what should I do?! Gold
Ship is going
around campus putting
handmade stickers up
everywhere!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
What?! Is she pulling another one of
those
ridiculous pranks?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Whoever peeps inside this tree stump is gonna be in for a big surprise.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Expectin' some ants or bugs, were ya? Think again, sucker! You get Golshi's smug mug givin' you a funny look! Haha, everyone's gonna love this!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: You there! Голд Шип!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, who called the fun police? Fame
sure is a
double-edged sword.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Wait... WAIT! Голд Шип!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
As the famed Dr. Golstein once said,
"Golshi
don't wait for no one!"
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Enough of your nonsense!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Don't you dare underestimate me!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув catches up to Голд Шипп and
blocks
her way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! That was quite a nip! Famed

Empress—prithee, share your secrets!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
My secrets? Being provoked by the likes
of
you—that's all there is to it.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Fascinating... So I guess that means
you're pretty
ticked off?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Who's to say? At any rate, you need to
come with
me to the student council
office.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It appears Голд Шипп finally understands
the error
of her ways. Furthermore, I
have learned of your
secret hidden
strength, Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: All in all, I'd call this a positive result!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have a hard time believing she's truly
learned
her lesson...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Homemade stickers, eh... Sticker...
Stick...
Quick... Trick... Ah!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
"The trick to getting good quick is to
follow the
stickers' stick!" What do you
think?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Uh... That was lovely.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув sounds exasperated, but the
incident
seems to have a positive effect
on her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
